item.text:
For Mistral’s hosted Code Interpreter, the official documentation does not specify a numeric execution-time limit or describe a special over-time response. It only documents that executions produce a `tool.execution` entry with start and completion timestamps, plus the code output. [Code Interpreter documentation](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/agents/agent-tools/code_interpreter)

If you mean Mistral Workflows rather than the hosted Agent Code Interpreter, there is an explicit `execution_timeout`. When exceeded, the execution ends in the terminal `TIMED_OUT` state. [Workflow execution statuses](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/workflows/getting-started/core_concepts/executions)
